title: Chicken Chilli Wrap
description: A delicious wrap filled with spicy chicken, chilli sauce, and a hint of dutch mixture. This recipe is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and dutch mixture.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before slicing.
Warm the wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spreading chilli sauce on each wrap, then topping with sliced chicken, with, and sauce.
